question: In the Campi Flegrei drill, what does “assisted mode” mean?
answer: In the Campi Flegrei drill, assisted mode moves only the people who cannot leave on their own. They are picked up at point A and carried to point B. Anyone who would evacuate by themselves is not part of the test at all.
move: An assisted drill tests the rides, not the whole crowd leaving.

web.label: Quiz card asking what 'assisted mode' means in the Campi Flegrei evacuation drill. Four choices: everyone leaves, guided by staff; only people who can't leave on their own are moved; only people driving their own cars; only those who can't leave alone.

source: Geopop, “RISCHIO VULCANICO CAMPI FLEGREI: LA SIMULAZIONE D'EVACUAZIONE FUNZIONERA? Considerazioni e dubbi” (YouTube, 2019)
